name: openstory
description: Generate AI images and video, mint a library style from refs (create-style), turn a script into a multi-scene AI video (create-sequence), play a cut from clips, stills, and a music bed (stitch), and connect the OpenStory MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: AI images, video, and full sequences
interface.longDescription: Generate images and video clips directly from a prompt, reference images, or start and end frames. Mint a library style from refs, turn a script into a multi-scene AI video, and share a cut of clips, stills, and a music bed. Installing the plugin also connects the hosted OpenStory MCP server at https://openstory.so/mcp. Sign-in is OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Generate a 5-second OpenStory video of a lighthouse at dusk
Turn this script into an OpenStory sequence
Mint an OpenStory style from these references
